name: How do you make an in-law suite feel like a separate home?

mainEntity.name: How do you make an in-law suite feel like a separate home?
mainEntity.text: How do you make an in-law suite feel like a separate home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A true sense of independence comes from both layout and experience. Separate entry access, a complete or near-complete kitchen, a full bathroom, dedicated storage, and a living area that does not force passage through the main house all help. Inside, use finishes and lighting that make the space feel intentional rather than improvised. Outside, a distinct pathway, lighting, and landscaping can make the suite feel like its own destination. Privacy and comfort matter as much as square footage. Homeowners should think about how a guest, parent, or future occupant will move through the space from morning to night. A well-designed suite should feel easy to live in without constantly overlapping with the main home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A suite feels more like a separate home when it has its own entrance, bathroom, kitchen, storage, and clearly defined living areas. Good sound insulation, independent lighting zones, and thoughtful exterior design also help. The more the suite can function on its own, the more private and usable it feels.
